checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable 15-second widescreen film with three sequential scenes
must.why: Output is a single 5-second clip with one scene.

must.item: Woman curly black bob and yellow raincoat; man white beard and blue coat
must.why: Woman has long straight dark hair and a pastel plaid shirt; man is clean-shaven with a gray-green shirt.
Dry bench in sunny autumn park, no rain or wetness.

must.item: Man offers folded newspaper; ending shows both seated and smiling
must.why: No newspaper; food is shared. Both are seated and smiling at the end, but the newspaper gesture is missing.

must.item: Live-action appearance and no audible soundtrack
must.why: Looks photoreal; the response says sound was not added, so it is presumably silent.

faults.what: Only a 5s single scene instead of 15s with three scenes
Character descriptions (curly black bob, yellow raincoat, white beard, blue coat) are not matched
No wet bench or rain; no newspaper gesture
Hands and the food item look slightly mushy

summary: The video is a pleasant, realistic 5-second clip of a woman sharing food with an old man on a bench, but it misses nearly every specified requirement: 15 seconds, three scenes, the wet bench, the newspaper, and the character looks.
